summary: SEO testing for Schema.org JSON-LD, meta tags, sitemap/robots.txt. All 3 JSON-LD schemas (ProfessionalService, FAQPage, WebSite) render correctly via useEffect injection in App.js. sitemap.xml and robots.txt accessible. Navigation works. Found 1 bug: static canonical link in index.html overrides dynamic canonical from SEO component.

integration_issues.issue: Static canonical link in index.html (line 11) prevents react-helmet-async from setting dynamic canonical URLs per page. All pages show canonical as homepage URL instead of current page URL.

passed_tests: TEST 1: 3 JSON-LD Schema.org scripts render in DOM - ProfessionalService, FAQPage, WebSite all present
TEST 2: ProfessionalService schema has correct name, url, priceRange, 4 offers
TEST 3: FAQPage schema has 4 FAQ questions with answers
TEST 4: WebSite schema has correct name, url, SearchAction
TEST 5: Homepage title 'Accueil | Stratégie & Expertise Santé' - contains site name
TEST 7: Meta description exists and is substantial (>50 chars)
TEST 8: og:title, og:description, og:url, og:type, og:site_name, og:locale all present
TEST 9: /sitemap.xml returns valid XML with 23 URLs
TEST 10: /robots.txt has User-agent, Allow, Disallow /admin, and Sitemap URL
TEST 12: Each page has unique title tag via SEO component
TEST 13: og:url is set correctly per page by react-helmet
failed_tests: TEST 14: Canonical URL not dynamic - index.html line 11 has static canonical that overrides react-helmet
action_items: CRITICAL: Remove static <link rel='canonical' href='https://secure-payment-flow-5.preview.emergentagent.com/' /> from index.html line 11 - it prevents react-helmet-async from setting per-page canonical URLs. The SEO.jsx component already handles this dynamically.
critical_code_review_comments: Schema.org JSON-LD injection via useEffect in App.js is working correctly - all 3 schemas render
SEO.jsx component properly sets title, meta tags, og tags, and canonical per page
BUG: index.html has static canonical link (line 11) that conflicts with dynamic react-helmet canonical
sitemap.xml and robots.txt are properly configured in /public folder
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO features mostly working. JSON-LD schemas render correctly via useEffect. Main issue: static canonical in index.html line 11 needs to be removed so react-helmet can set dynamic per-page canonicals.
